correctness.rationale: For every fixed sufficiently large parent, Marques Proposition 2.1 and Lemma 2.3 give a positive linear count of admissible indices, while Lemma 2.2 uniformly bounds indices per 20/N window. Thus c_t N separated children exist. The finite-parent common-block choice ensures uniform B_j >=2 and log B_j/log N_j tending to one. Separation forces small cylinder-ball masses, and the countable-upper-box characterization proves packing dimension one. Every admissible chain has exact exponent tau and smooth convergents by the full inequalities of the source Section 2. The one-fraction-per-denominator limsup cover proves zero Hausdorff dimension for the entire locus. No unverified calculation is required.

value.rationale: The joint dimension spectrum is a natural, meaningful metric classification of a locus recently shown to refute a famous continued-fraction conjecture. The same set has zero Hausdorff dimension but full packing dimension at every finite permitted exponent; the many-branch enhancement is mathematically substantive, not an arbitrary finite example or an isolated numerical improvement.
